mapper.insert:
insert into score_detail
id,
student_no,
test_no,
question_no,
student_score,
question_type,
flag,
create_time,
student_answer,
grader_no,
locked_at,
#{id,jdbcType=BIGINT},
#{studentNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
#{testNo,jdbcType=BIGINT},
#{questionNo,jdbcType=BIGINT},
#{studentScore,jdbcType=INTEGER},
#{questionType,jdbcType=CHAR},
#{flag,jdbcType=CHAR},
#{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
#{studentAnswer,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR},
#{graderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
#{lockedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
mapper.select: select sd.id as id, t.name as testName, s.question as questionName, sd.student_answer as studentAnswer, s.answer as answer, sd.question_score as questionScore, sd.question_type as questionType, sd.flag as flag, sd.grader_no as graderNo, sd.locked_at as lockedAt from score_detail sd left join test t on t.id = sd.test_no left join subjective s on s.id = sd.question_no where sd.test_no = #{testNo} and sd.question_type = '4' and sd.flag = '0' order by sd.id asc limit 1
mapper.update: update score_detail set student_score = #{score}, flag = '1', grader_no = null, locked_at = null where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, student_no, test_no, question_no, student_score, question_score, question_type, flag, create_time, grader_no, locked_at, student_answer from score_detail where test_no = #{testNo} and question_type != '4' and flag = '0'
select student_no as studentNo, test_no as testNo, SUM(student_score) as total from score_detail where test_no = #{testNo} group by student_no

select sd.id as id, t.name as testName, s.question as questionName, sd.student_answer as studentAnswer, s.answer as answer, sd.question_score as questionScore, sd.question_type as questionType, sd.flag as flag, sd.grader_no as graderNo, sd.locked_at as lockedAt from score_detail sd left join test t on t.id = sd.test_no left join subjective s on s.id = sd.question_no where sd.test_no = #{testNo} and sd.question_type = '4' and sd.flag = '2' order by sd.id asc limit 1
mapper.update: update score_detail set flag = '0', grader_no = null, locked_at = null where id = #{id} and flag = '2'
mapper.select: select sd.id as id, sd.student_no as studentNo, st.name as studentName, sd.test_no as testNo, t.name as testName, sd.question_no as questionNo, sj.question as questionContent, sj.answer as referenceAnswer, sd.student_answer as studentAnswer, sd.question_score as questionScore, sd.student_score as studentScore, sd.flag as flag, sd.grader_no as graderNo, sd.locked_at as lockedAt from score_detail sd left join test t on t.id = sd.test_no left join subjective sj on sj.id = sd.question_no and sd.question_type = '4' left join student st on st.student_no = sd.student_no where sd.test_no = #{testNo} and sd.question_type = '4' order by sd.id asc

select tq.test_no as testNo, tq.question_no as questionNo, tq.question_type as questionType, case when tq.question_type in ('1','2','3') then c.question when tq.question_type = '4' then s.question else '未知题型' end as questionContent, case when tq.question_type in ('1','2','3') then c.answer when tq.question_type = '4' then s.answer else null end as referenceAnswer from test_question tq left join choice c on tq.question_no = c.id and tq.question_type in ('1','2','3') left join subjective s on tq.question_no = s.id and tq.question_type = '4' where tq.test_no = #{testNo} order by tq.id asc

select sd.student_answer as studentAnswer, t.name as testName, case when sd.question_type in ('1','2','3') then c.question when sd.question_type = '4' then s.question else '未知题型' end as questionContent, case when sd.question_type in ('1','2','3') then c.answer when sd.question_type = '4' then s.answer else 'N/A' end as correctAnswer, '' as analysis from score_detail sd left join test t on sd.test_no = t.id left join choice c on sd.question_no = c.id and sd.question_type in ('1','2','3') left join subjective s on sd.question_no = s.id and sd.question_type = '4' where sd.student_no = #{studentNo} and (sd.student_score is null or sd.student_score = 0) order by sd.id desc
